card.name: Word-start "trans" in medical terms
card.fires_on: The pole responds most strongly to "tran" or "trans" at the start of a word that is still being spelled out, such as transthyretin, transdermal, transplant or transport. It sometimes also fires on a blank space before a number in a figure or section reference.
